name: Sunray Eagle 2-Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna 200D1
description: Description The SunRay Eagle 2-Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna is built from aged Canadian hemlock wood with a shingled roof for outdoor protection. Double-paneled wall construction ensures excellent heat retention, while a front window brings in natural light. A 4.5 kW electric heater with lava rocks produces traditional steam heat up to 170°F. The Eagle also includes chromatherapy mood lighting, Bluetooth speakers, a hygrometer, a sand timer, and a 44-inch wide bench for two-person comfort.
